name: agent-office
description: An animated isometric pixel-art office where every Claude Code agent of the session is a little pixel person: typing at its desk, thinking, raising a hand for a decision, drinking coffee while it waits, jumping and going home when done; with name tags, a cost HUD and an event log. It is a local web page that opens in the system browser; the «Офис» pane holds a short summary and the link.
